031416: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_expression_task_push(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame, CIrLowerFrame task, u32 token_index)
031417: {
031418:     if (!frame->as.expression.tasks)
031419:     {
031420:         frame->as.expression.task_capacity = frame->as.expression.end - frame->as.expression.start + 1;
031421:         frame->as.expression.tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrLowerFrame, frame->as.expression.task_capacity);
031422:     }
031423:     if (frame->as.expression.task_count >= frame->as.expression.task_capacity)
031424:     {
031425:         builder->failure_message = S8("C expression nesting exceeds the lowering frame capacity");
031426:         builder->failure_token_index = token_index;
031427:         return false;
031428:     }
031429:     frame->as.expression.tasks[frame->as.expression.task_count++] = task;
031430:     return true;
031431: }

031433: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_expression_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
031434: {
031435:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
031436:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
031437:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
031438:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION);
031439:     bool unwind = false;
031440:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
031441:     {
031442:         if (frame->as.expression.start >= frame->as.expression.end || frame->as.expression.end > builder->preprocess.token_count)
031443:         {
031444:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031445:             return;
031446:         }
031447:         frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
031448:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
031449:     }
031450:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VALUE)
031451:     {
031452:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
031453:         {
031454:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031455:             return;
031456:         }
031457:         frame->as.expression.value = machine->child_result.value;
031458:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
031459:         unwind = true;
031460:     }
031461:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VOID_ASSIGNMENT)
031462:     {
031463:         // A cast to void still evaluates an assignment for its side effect.
031464:         // Lower the assignment through the statement machine and provide the
031465:         // discarded value expected by the surrounding comma/expression walk.
031466:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
031467:         {
031468:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031469:             return;
031470:         }
031471:         frame->as.expression.value = c_ir_emit_integer_value(builder, 0, false, (CToken){0});
031472:         if (frame->as.expression.value.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
031473:         {
031474:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031475:             return;
031476:         }
031477:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
031478:         unwind = true;
031479:     }
031480:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_PLACE)
031481:     {
031482:         IrValueId place = machine->child_result.value;
031483:         u32 assignment = frame->as.expression.pending_assignment;
031484:         if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
031485:         {
031486:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031487:             return;
031488:         }
031489:         // A parenthesized place may contain an address-of/dereference chain,
031490:         // as in Lua's setnilvalue macro: `((&(p->val))->tt_ = value)`.
031491:         // The expression child materializes that field as a load, while the
031492:         // assignment still needs its underlying place.  Recover the final
031493:         // load's operand exactly as the general assignment statement path
031494:         // does, removing the now-redundant load from the current block.
031495:         place = c_ir_recover_place_from_value(builder, place);
031496:         if (place.value >= builder->function->value_count || builder->function->values[place.value].category != IR_VALUE_PLACE)
031497:         {
031498:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031499:             return;
031500:         }
031501:         CToken operator_token = builder->preprocess.tokens[assignment];
031502:         CIrLowerFrame task = {
031503:             .kind = C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ASSIGNMENT_COMPLETION,
031504:             .as.assignment =
031505:                 {
031506:                     .place = place,
031507:                     .type = builder->function->values[place.value].canonical_type,
031508:                     .source = c_ir_token_source_range(builder, operator_token),
031509:                     .operation = frame->as.expression.pending_operation,
031510:                     .simple = c_token_is_punctuator(&operator_token, C_PUNCTUATOR_ASSIGN),
031511:                 },
031512:         };
031513:         if (!c_ir_expression_task_push(builder, frame, task, assignment))
031514:         {
031515:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031516:             return;
031517:         }
031518:         frame->as.expression.start = assignment + 1;
031519:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
031520:     }
031521:     else
031522:     {
031523:         BUSTER_CHECK(frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_CONDITION);
031524:         if (!machine->child_result.success || !frame->as.expression.task_count)
031525:         {
031526:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031527:             return;
031528:         }
031529:         CIrLowerFrame* task = &frame->as.expression.tasks[frame->as.expression.task_count - 1];
031530:         BUSTER_CHECK(task->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_ARITHMETIC_CONDITIONAL_LEFT);
031531:         if (!c_ir_switch_block(builder, frame->as.expression.pending_true_block))
031532:         {
031533:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
031534:             return;
031535:         }
031536:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
031537:     }
